curl-openssl.description: Use the built-in libcurl client with OpenSSL on Linux and Android.

device-id.description: Enable native device-ID collection. Foundry intentionally omits this feature.

minimal-sqlite.description: Build private feature-stripped SQLite on non-Apple platforms; Apple uses OS SQLite.

no-logging.description: Compile out internal SDK diagnostics without disabling telemetry event collection.

system-sqlite.description: Use the external vcpkg sqlite3 package for offline storage.
